purpose: Hand-authored API conformance and semantic smoke cases, frozen before inference. Not a general quality benchmark.

cases.state: Hello. The shop already issued my refund last Tuesday, but it has not reached my card. Please check its status. I am calm and happy to wait for an update.

route.instructions: Choose the primary intent supported by the message.

criteria.new_refund: Request a refund that has not yet been issued
criteria.missing_refund: Check a refund already issued but not received

already_issued.instructions: Does the message explicitly say the refund has already been issued?

anger.instructions: Rate the anger explicitly expressed in the message.

instructions.rule: Review if amount is above the stated threshold or the required receipt is missing; otherwise accept

requirements_met.instructions: Count the two requirements met: amount at or below threshold, and receipt attached.

state.text: The museum opens at 09:00 on weekdays.

best_passage.instructions: Which passage directly answers when the museum opens on weekdays?

answer_present.instructions: Does any supplied passage give the museum's weekday opening time?

weekend_time_present.instructions: Does any supplied passage explicitly state the museum's weekend opening time?

observations: Web requests fail with DNS name not found
Connecting to the known server IP succeeds
available_checks: Inspect DNS records without changing them

next_check.instructions: Select the read-only check most directly related to the observed failure.

ip_reachable.instructions: Do the observations state that connecting by known IP succeeds?

criteria.true: A successful known-IP connection is explicitly observed

disk_evidence.instructions: Rate only the evidence for a disk fault in the supplied observations.
criteria: An explicit disk error is reported

cases.state: Contact Morgan at morgan@example.test about order A-104. The delivery address is not provided.

instructions: Select the supplied span that is the contact email.
Do not create a new value.

has_address.instructions: Is a physical delivery address provided?

cases.state: The appointment is on 2026-11-05. It is a specific calendar date, not a relative expression such as tomorrow.

month.instructions: Which month is written in the supplied date?

relative.instructions: Is the actual appointment expressed relative to today instead of as a calendar date?

state.item: A rechargeable battery-powered bicycle with two wheels and pedals

top.instructions: Choose the top category for the item.

vehicle_child.instructions: Choose the vehicle subtype supported by the item description.

rechargeable.instructions: Is a rechargeable battery explicitly mentioned?

state.request: Show my calendar events for Monday. Do not change anything.

function.instructions: Choose the function that satisfies the request.

allows_changes.instructions: Does the user permit changing stored data?

same_place.instructions: Do the two records refer to the same geographic place, considering country and id?

match_level.instructions: Classify geographic identity. Distinct countries and ids mean different places.

state.message: Please permanently delete the archived test folder.
state.policy: Deletion requires review. Read-only listing does not require review.

action_kind.instructions: Classify the requested action, without executing it.

requires_review.instructions: Under the supplied policy, does this request require review?

explicit_permanence.instructions: Does the message explicitly use the word permanently?

state.source: Project Cedar launched in March 2024. The team had five members.

claim_one.instructions: How does the supplied source relate to claim one?

claim_two.instructions: How does the supplied source relate to claim two?

claim_three.instructions: How does the supplied source relate to claim three?

cases.state: The screen is excellent and the keyboard works perfectly. The battery failed completely on the first day. I did not test the speakers.

true.definition: The text explicitly reports that the battery failed

screen_sentiment.instructions: Rate only the opinion about the screen.

speaker_tested.instructions: Were the speakers tested according to the text?
